plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner read: bottle on the left, headline and subheadline stacked in a wide block, then a readable logo lockup and the CTA button closing on the right.
Brand-and-action column on the right: the logo sits stacked directly above the CTA so brand and button work as one group, which leaves the headline a wide text block next to the bottle.
The brand leads: the logo lockup opens the strip on the far left, followed by the bottle as a product sign, then the headline block, and the CTA ends the line on the right.
